guide_dependency: Do not start until the revised Stage 1 applicability guide is human-confirmed and version-frozen.

targeted_cells.HIGH: Both Core reviewers re-review every currently valid Core-disagreement cell for every HIGH label: 684 cells before any overlap with later completion work.
targeted_cells.HIGH_controls: For each HIGH label, add 10 deterministic exact-agreement controls where available: balanced across NO, PLAUSIBLE, CLEAR and source, selected by SHA-256 rank; controls are mixed into the packet without revealing status.
targeted_cells.MEDIUM: Both Core reviewers re-review every current NO-CLEAR severe disagreement for MEDIUM labels: 91 cells before completion-work overlap.
targeted_cells.MEDIUM_controls: For each MEDIUM label, add 5 deterministic exact-agreement controls where available, source-balanced and masked.
targeted_cells.LOW: No default re-review. Any persistent severe LOW-label case goes to the later adjudication queue under the frozen guide.

core_reviewer_policy.randomization: Mix disagreement cells and controls using deterministic seed 44.
core_reviewer_policy.legacy_fields: Do not display, fill, or analyze evidence, rank_order, or tie_group.

reviewer2_tail.timing: After revised guide freeze, before post-review agreement measurement.
reviewer2_tail.procedure: Reviewer 2 completes all 38 samples by 18 labels as new real judgments. Reviewer 1 independently refreshes the same 684 cells under the same guide; neither sees any placeholder or prior value.

reviewer1_missing.paired_policy: Reviewer 2 also blindly refreshes these four cells because all four labels receive HIGH or MEDIUM guide clarification.

versioning.new_columns_or_artifact: Store re-review values in a separate versioned artifact with guide_version, reviewer_id, sample_id, label, applicability, and timestamp.

stop_rule: After post-re-review statistics are produced, stop. Freeze adjudication only if its predetermined gates pass; do not automatically widen to full re-review or begin adjudication.
